title: Synthetic constrained allocation laboratory
provenance: Original pedagogical inputs, created for this library; not observed data or calibrated market estimates.
units: x and y are normalized activity units; a and b are objective units per activity unit; p and q are objective units per squared activity unit; w converts y into resource units; B is resource capacity.
model: maximize a*x + b*y - (p*x*x + q*y*y)/2 subject to x>=0, y>=0, x+w*y<=B
numerical_certificate_scope: Floating-point calculations are instructional and assume reliable arithmetic; these are not outward-rounded interval certificates.
